evals.name: folklore-vs-documented
evals.prompt: im about to start building a browser game for crazygames and i want to get the constraints right before i write any code. what do i actually need to hit? ive read that it has to run at a locked 60fps, that everything has to be webp and ogg, and that you cant use localStorage because of their sandbox. is all that right? give me the real list.
evals.expected_output: Corrects all three false premises explicitly as NOT documented, and supplies the real documented constraints (1 click to gameplay, legibility sizes, 50/20MB initial download, 144/165Hz physics, mouse+keyboard+touch, relative paths).
assertions: States that no framerate/60 FPS requirement is documented, correcting the user's premise
States that no required or banned file formats are documented (webp/ogg is folklore)
States that localStorage is not documented as blocked
Gives the max-1-click-to-gameplay rule
Gives the 50 MB initial download limit (and/or the 20 MB mobile-homepage figure)
Gives at least one of the QA legibility resolutions (821x462 or 800x450)
Mentions frame-rate independence at 144 Hz and 165 Hz as the real timing rule
Mentions the relative-paths-only requirement
Explicitly separates documented facts from things the docs do not state

evals.prompt: here's my game loop - a wave survival thing, sessions run about 8-10 min. i want to put ads in. where do they go and what do i have to call? plain html5 canvas, no engine.
evals.name: ad-placement-and-sdk
evals.expected_output: Uses v3 SDK with awaited init(), the four game events, requestAd with midgame/rewarded and the callback shape. States mute+pause on adStarted, no reward on adError, never during gameplay, and the 1-per-3-minutes server-side cap.
assertions: Uses SDK v3 (crazygames-sdk-v3.js and/or awaited SDK.init()), not v2 calls like sdkGameLoadingStart
Shows requestAd with the ad type string 'midgame' and/or 'rewarded'
Shows the adStarted/adFinished/adError callback shape
States that audio must be muted while the ad plays
States that the game must be paused during the ad
States that ads must not interrupt active gameplay, only transitions
States the 1-midgame-ad-per-3-minutes cap
States that no reward is granted on adError
Mentions gameplayStart/gameplayStop around the ad or the session

evals.name: prelaunch-audit
evals.prompt: my game is done and built to ./dist, im about to submit it. can you check it over and tell me whats going to get me rejected? also what cover art do i need to make
evals.expected_output: Runs the bundled check-build.mjs against dist, reports its findings, is explicit about what the script cannot check, and gives the three cover sizes (1920x1080, 800x1200, 800x800).
assertions: Actually runs or reports the output of the bundled check-build.mjs script
Identifies the absolute asset paths in the fixture as a blocking problem
Identifies that the fixture ships the v2 SDK and that v3 is current
Identifies the prohibited requestFullscreen call
Is explicit that some requirements (legibility, ad placement, originality) are not machine-checkable
Gives all three cover sizes: 1920x1080, 800x1200, 800x800
